useWhen: Setting up product analytics for the first time
Improving an existing dashboard with better visualizations
Deciding what metrics to display on operational dashboards
Choosing the right analytics tools for your stage

workflow.description: Define what business questions the dashboard needs to answer
Determine what data is available and how to connect to it
Select metrics that answer your business questions
Create layout and choose appropriate visualizations for each metric
Configure notifications for threshold breaches or anomalies

examples.input: Create an operational dashboard for a B2B SaaS product to track acquisition, activation, and retention metrics.
examples.context: B2B SaaS with 500 paying customers, using Mixpanel and Stripe
examples.output:
**DASHBOARD OVERVIEW**
- Purpose: Track product health and user journey
- Audience: Product team, executives
- Refresh: Real-time

**DATA SOURCES**
- Mixpanel: User events, funnels, retention
- Stripe: Revenue, subscriptions
- PostgreSQL: User data, usage

**METRICS**

| Metric | Calculation | Viz Type | Benchmark |
|--------|-------------|----------|----------|
| Daily Signups | Count of new accounts | Line chart | Growing trend |
| Activation Rate | Users completing key action / total | % gauge | 30%+ |
| Time to Activation | Avg days from signup to activation | Histogram | <3 days |
| Weekly Active Users | Users with 1+ action/week | Line chart | Stable/growing |
| MRR | Monthly recurring revenue | Line chart | Growing |
| Churn Rate | Lost customers / total | % gauge | <5% |

**DASHBOARD SECTIONS**
- Top: KPIs overview (4 key metrics)
- Middle: Acquisition funnel
- Bottom: Retention curves
- Side: Revenue metrics

**ALERTS**
- Signups drop >50%: Slack to #product
- Churn >5%: Email to exec team
- MRR decline: Page on-call

examples.input: Build a dashboard for a mobile app to track engagement and monetization metrics.
examples.context: Consumer mobile app with freemium model, using Firebase and Adjust
examples.output:
**DASHBOARD OVERVIEW**
- Purpose: Monitor daily engagement and revenue
- Audience: Product, Marketing
- Refresh: Daily

**DATA SOURCES**
- Firebase Analytics: Events, sessions, user properties
- Adjust: Install attribution, ad revenue
- App Store: In-app purchases

**METRICS**

| Metric | Calculation | Viz Type | Benchmark |
|--------|-------------|----------|----------|
| DAU | Unique users opening app | Area chart | Growing |
| Session Length | Avg time per session | Bar chart | >10 min |
| DAU/MAU | Stickiness | % gauge | >25% |
| D1 Retention | Return on day 1 | % | >40% |
| D7 Retention | Return on day 7 | % | >20% |
| ARPPU | Revenue / paying users | Trend | Growing |

**IMPLEMENTATION**
- Tool: Google Data Studio (free)
- Connect Firebase + Adjust data sources
- Build calculated fields for KPIs
- Schedule daily email reports
